```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = FALSE)
```

This dashboard covers the package's selected catalog, not every publisher
dataset. The package retrieves records without hosting or archiving them.

Health checks test endpoints and metadata. They do not confirm record
freshness or guarantee a full download.

```{r coverage-dashboard, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=TRUE}
catalog <- tampaBayOpenData::tbod_list_datasets(source = "checked")
health <- getFromNamespace(".coverage_load_health_report", "tampaBayOpenData")()
coverage <- getFromNamespace(".coverage_dashboard_data", "tampaBayOpenData")(
  catalog, health
)
cat(getFromNamespace(".coverage_dashboard_html", "tampaBayOpenData")(
  coverage
))
```

<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.querySelector('.tb-coverage-dashboard');
  if (!root) return;
  var controls = root.querySelector('#tb-coverage-filters');
  var count = root.querySelector('#tb-coverage-count');
  var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('#tb-coverage-datasets tbody tr[data-status]'));
  var search = root.querySelector('#tb-coverage-search');
  var publisher = root.querySelector('#tb-coverage-publisher');
  var status = root.querySelector('#tb-coverage-status');
  if (!controls || !count || !search || !publisher || !status) return;
  controls.hidden = false;
  count.hidden = false;
  function filterRows() {
    var term = search.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    var shown = 0;
    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      var matches = (!term || row.textContent.toLocaleLowerCase().indexOf(term) !== -1) &&
        (!publisher.value || row.dataset.publisher === publisher.value) &&
        (!status.value || row.dataset.status === status.value);
      row.hidden = !matches;
      if (matches) shown += 1;
    });
    count.textContent = shown + ' of ' + rows.length + ' checked datasets shown';
  }
  search.addEventListener('input', filterRows);
  publisher.addEventListener('change', filterRows);
  status.addEventListener('change', filterRows);
  filterRows();
}());
</script>

## Read the dashboard

Counts come from the bundled catalog. Health reports must match the current
entry and endpoint, be no older than 30 days, and be at least as recent as
the catalog check. Recent failures are problematic; stale, absent, mismatched,
or inconclusive results are unverified.

Layers without saved schemas cannot receive field and geometry comparisons.
Health checks inspect metadata only. See the
[catalog policy](https://github.com/Jaclenga/tampaBayOpenData/blob/main/docs/checked-catalog-policy.md)
and [discovery guide](discovery.html) for selection and search limits.

## Check what each source covers

- Tampa permits and development cases cover active views, not full histories.
- City boundaries and park buffers need careful interpretation.
- Housing inventories, transit routes, and historical storm-surge models
  do not confirm eligibility, schedules, or current emergency conditions.

Read each layer's `scope_note` and source metadata before analysis.

```{r inspect-source}
library(tampaBayOpenData)

info <- tbod_dataset_info("tampa-construction-permits")
info[c("title", "source_url", "scope_note", "terms", "verified")]
```

`source_url`, `scope_note`, and `terms` describe the source and reuse conditions.

`verified` dates an endpoint check. Portal `modified` dates may also differ
from individual record dates.

## Keep provenance with results

Save the source, query, retrieval time, and completeness details with the data:

```{r preserve-provenance}
projects <- tbod_get_dataset("tampa-development-cases", spatial = TRUE, out_sr = 4326)
source <- tbod_provenance(projects)
saveRDS(list(data = projects, provenance = source), "development-cases.rds")
```

Transformations may drop provenance attributes. Retrieval checks detect
missing or repeated IDs, but live attributes can change during a download.
See [retrieval](retrieval.html).

## Check catalog health

Check selected layers against current metadata:

```{r catalog-health}
health <- tbod_check_catalog(ids = c("tampa-construction-permits", "st-pete-parks"))
health[, c("dataset_id", "status", "schema_status", "details")]
```

Read `status`, `schema_status`, and `details` for each result.

Statuses include `healthy`, `unavailable`, `schema_changed`, `unsupported`,
and `unknown`. Inspect `schema_issues` or `failure_type` for details.
A healthy result applies to the endpoint and schema at check time.

See the [test guide](https://github.com/Jaclenga/tampaBayOpenData/blob/main/tests/README.md)
and [validation record](https://github.com/Jaclenga/tampaBayOpenData/blob/main/docs/validation.md)
for monitoring details.

The weekly [health workflow](https://github.com/Jaclenga/tampaBayOpenData/blob/main/.github/workflows/catalog-health.yaml)
saves reports without changing the catalog.

## Cite the package and its data sources

Get the package citation:

```{r citation}
citation("tampaBayOpenData")
toBibtex(citation("tampaBayOpenData"))
```

Also cite the original publisher and dataset, including retrieval time.
The package's MIT license covers its software; each publisher sets data terms.
The package is independent of the publishers and rOpenSci.
